title: Operations Associate, Inventory Intelligence
summary: Tracks garment location and condition across the Brooklyn warehouse, investigates count discrepancies, and owns the daily shrinkage report.
description_text:
Operations Associate, Inventory Intelligence

Rent the Runway is looking for an Operations Associate to join the Inventory Intelligence team at our Brooklyn facility.

Responsibilities
- Track garment location and condition through the cleaning, inspection, and restock cycle.
- Investigate count discrepancies between the warehouse management system and physical counts.
- Own the daily shrinkage report and present findings at the Monday operations review.

Requirements
- 2+ years in warehouse, retail, or logistics operations.
- Comfortable in Excel; SQL is a plus but we will teach it.
- On site five days per week in Brooklyn.

Compensation: $58,000 - $66,000.
